machine_name.description: Name of the machine, used in logs and GUI titlebar.

emc_debug_level.description: Debug verbosity level (0–99). Higher = more logs. Start at 0 for production.

display_type.description: GUI type: AXIS (default), TK, QTVCP, or custom.

display_ui_path.description: Path to a QTVCP .ui file (optional). Leave empty for default AXIS.

display_cycle_time.description: GUI refresh interval in milliseconds (100 = 10 Hz). Lower = smoother UI, but higher CPU use.

position_offset.description: Position display source: ACTUAL (encoder feedback) or COMMANDED (commanded positions).

position_feedback.description: Position display mode: RELATIVE (G91) or MACHINE (G53).

default_linear_units.description: Default linear unit system: MM (millimeters) or INCHES.

default_angular_units.description: Default angular unit system: DEGREES or RADIANS.

halfile_path.description: Path to the primary HAL configuration file loaded at startup.

halfile_extra.description: Additional HAL files (relative paths) to load in order. Useful for custom hardware.

startup_gcode_path.description: Optional G-code file to run after HAL load (e.g., tool change setup).

subroutine_path.description: Directory path containing user G-code subroutines (M-codes, etc.).

error_log_level.description: Log level for error reporting: LOG (info), WARN (warnings), ERROR (errors only).

emcmot_comm_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for communications with the motion controller.

emcmot_comm_wait.description: Time (seconds) to wait for motion controller heartbeat before timeout.

base_period.description: Base task period (seconds) for real-time scheduler. Must match HAL base thread period (e.g., 1ms).

servo_period.description: Servo task period (seconds); usually same as BASE_PERIOD for rigid motion control.

hal_files.description: List of HAL configuration files to load via loadusr. Each entry specifies file name, path, and load priority.

halui_modules.description: List of HAL UI module names (e.g., 'halui') to load for custom user interface extensions.

traj_axes.description: Total number of axes (including spindles as virtual axes). Must match sum of [AXIS_#] sections.

traj_max_linear_velocity.description: Machine-wide maximum linear velocity (in configured units per second).

traj_default_linear_accel.description: Default linear acceleration (e.g., mm/s²) applied if not overridden in axis section.

traj_max_linear_accel.description: Absolute maximum linear acceleration allowed across axes.

traj_max_angular_velocity.description: Maximum angular velocity (e.g., for A/B/C axes) in deg/s or rad/s as per DEFAULT_ANGULAR_UNITS.

axis_0.description: Axis 0 configuration (typically X-axis). Required for ≥1 axis.

axis_1.description: Optional Axis 1 (Y-axis). Omit if not needed.

axis_2.description: Optional Axis 2 (Z-axis). Omit if not needed.

axis_3.description: Optional Axis 3 (e.g., A-axis rotary). Omit if not needed.
